unshown_text.text: Statements are interim, unaudited, management-prepared for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 with nine-month comparatives for 2025.
Debt schedule rows on page 5 (revolving line of credit, term notes payable, total debt outstanding, term debt principal due within twelve months) were not placed; the template has no lines for them.
The cover page also states the units as in thousands of U.S. dollars; the scale phrase was taken from the balance sheet page.
All three covenants in the approved terms are reported in the summary table on the first page; the borrower reports non-compliance with the Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio.
No embedded instructions were found in the document.

The Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio for the four quarters ended September 30, 2026 is {{fact:5b61399a-8531-42bb-a229-39ef26af3fee}}. The minimum under Section 6.1 is {{fact:77721a76-1ddd-4eb0-9539-9ed32d14186a}}, so the ratio falls short by {{fact:b37d8dd6-944b-4c18-b234-30e87bc1ee47}}. This looks like a real breach. The borrower's Q3 2026 compliance certificate reports the same ratio, {{fact:3a9a3c97-f1e6-4f16-acce-83e6cc7bcddb}}, and says the borrower is not in compliance. Only one terms version is on file, the approved original agreement. There are no unapproved amendments, no add-backs apply to this covenant, and a search for a waiver found only the agreement's own Section 9.1 clause. That clause requires any waiver to be in writing and signed by both parties. Rerunning the test under version 1 gave the same result, {{fact:cd827479-b981-4d4f-abb8-7c465667babf}}, below the minimum of {{fact:b46d3981-8152-4f52-9b6d-4958d3366057}}. Nothing on file explains the failure away.
No separate over-advance line is printed; the certificate shows a single combined line labelled Availability (over-advance), reported under availability, so over_advance is omitted.
The Inventory sublimit line on the certificate does not match any requested line name and was not reported; advance rate percentage rows were skipped.
The aging and inventory pages also state units in U.S. dollars; the certificate page statement is reported.
The aging total row and the inventory total row were excluded as instructed.
The inventory page states that inventory was last counted at the most recent fiscal year end, with quantities from perpetual records.
No embedded instructions were found in the document.

The fixed charge coverage ratio of {{fact:5b61399a-8531-42bb-a229-39ef26af3fee}} sits below the {{fact:77721a76-1ddd-4eb0-9539-9ed32d14186a}} minimum, so headroom is negative at {{fact:b37d8dd6-944b-4c18-b234-30e87bc1ee47}}. This points to an outright shortfall, not just a thin cushion: cash flow is not covering fixed charges at the required level. No other signal fired this period to confirm or explain it.
